Anya: Quick follow-up on the postmortem action board — we have a few items slipping and need to decide reassign vs. extend deadlines.
Jordan: which items specifically? I can triage mine now.
Anya: INC-983 item #3 (large-schema rollforward) — originally Jordan, due 3/18. Blocked on infra prep (Priya), tests (Kai). Jordan, do you want to keep ownership or do we shift to Priya with Jordan as backup?
Jordan: I can stay on as owner but need an extra week. Happy to hand off if that helps velocity.
Priya: I can take primary if Jordan is OK to keep the review loop. My timeline would be due 3/25 — I need the infra slot confirmed.
Kai: tests are ~40% done. I can prioritize the test harness if we lock a cut of the schema this week. If Priya owns, I'd sync on the cutoff time.
Maya: FYI there's a downstream deployment planned Wed afternoon that depends on this. If we extend to 3/25 we should gate that deployment.
Sam: tagging release-planning: @release-planning — please hold Wed deploy until we confirm.
Anya: Proposal: shift ownership to Priya (primary) + Jordan (secondary), set new due 2025-03-25T17:00Z. Priya — ack?
Priya: ack, taking primary. I'll add a short checklist and request the infra slot from infra team.
Anya: Next: INC-983 item #7 (canary rollback test) assigned to Kai, due 3/20. It's small but flaky. Kai, do you want help from Sam on the canary harness?
Kai: yes please, Sam. I hit flaky failures on stage. Sam — can you help isolate the nondeterminism tomorrow morning?
Sam: sure, I'll pair at 10am. Can you paste the failing command?
Kai: reproduced with: ```kubectl -n canary exec -it canary-runner -- /bin/sh -c "./run_canary_test.sh --seed=42"``` failures are intermittent.
Sam: thanks. I'll run with `--seed=...` matrix and capture logs.
Anya: item #2 (postmortem doc action: add SLA rationale) — Maya originally, due 3/16. Maya, can you confirm status? Docs team needs it for the external summary.
Maya: sorry slipped — I have a draft, will finalize by EOD today (2025-03-19T23:00Z). Posting to the doc after lunch.
Anya: great. Infra-bot: can you confirm infra slot on 3/22 for Priya's rollout window?
infra-bot: scheduled maintenance window reserved 2025-03-22T02:00Z-06:00Z for eng-platform. Please add runbook link.
Anya: perfect. Action recap (quick):
- Priya: take ownership INC-983 #3, due 2025-03-25T17:00Z (Jordan backup)
- Kai + Sam: canary test triage, pair 2025-03-20T10:00Z
- Maya: SLA rationale doc update, EOD 2025-03-19
- Jordan: remain reviewer for schema cut
- Release-planning: hold Wed deploy until confirmation (:thumbsup:)
Jordan: noted, will keep PRs small and ping when ready for review.
Priya: I'll create the checklist and add links to runbook + migration plan.
Maya: posting doc in #docs-channel once updated.
Anya: if anyone prefers a reassignment instead of a shifted due, call it out now — otherwise I'll update the action board and ping owners.
Jordan: fine with the shift.
Kai: shift is fine.
Sam: fine.
Anya: thanks everyone. I'll update the board and send a short email to stakeholders after this thread.
